{{Quote|Sorry, I've been in the jungle too long. Forgot my manners. I'm Captain Jeelg with Imperial Reconnaissance.|Jeelg|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Imperial Reconnaissance''' was a division of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that focused on reconnaissance. In contrast to a regular trooper, members of Imperial Reconnaissance, (Known as Reconnaissance Troopers or Recon Troopers) would carry lighter, more flexible armor and in turn were faster. They were specially trained to use [[K-406 Combat Ripper|K-406 Sniper Rifles]]. These troopers were adaptable to any environment, due to their intense training. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jeelg]] led a unit in Imperial Reconnaissance on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], though his extreme paranoia led him to [[Death/Legends|kill]] all of his subordinates when he thought they were planning something&mdash;which turned out to be a surprise party for his promotion.
